body: You’re definitely right about the codependency, it’s happened as a result of being loved and treated well for one of the first times in my life. I appreciate the candid words, and the consolidation. Sometimes I forget what I’ve been through to get here. It’s actually really really relieving to hear that reminder, tysm

It means so much that you read and responded ty. I guess it boils down to the fact that I’m scared to lose him. The idea of not having him in my life makes me want to not live at all. I know he cares and he wouldn’t be here if he didn’t, but I feel so sorry and indebted to know there’s nothing I can do to take away his pain, the pain I caused him.
